description: This file defines the 'Add' feature for managing favorites in a web application, specifically handling the addition of articles to a user's favorites list. It includes command validation, and a request handler that interacts with the database context to perform the necessary operations.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Contains nested classes for command, validation, and request handling related to adding an article to user's favorites.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to add an article to favorites, including validation, database updates, and returning the article envelope.
